## Agenda Items


## 1. Budget Presentations
Throughout the month of June, the City Council will be discussing the City Manager's proposed budget line-by-line. This is a chance for the City Council to see where the City Manager wants to spend money. 

This meeting will cover the following: 

 - Municipal Services
 - Revenues
